crate.package: jacs-core, jacs-media, jacs, jacs-binding-core, jacs-mcp, jacs-cli, jacs-mcp-compat, jacs-cli-compat, jacs-wasm, jacs-mobile, jacsnpm, jacspy, jacsgo, jacs-duckdb, jacs-postgresql, jacs-redb, jacs-surrealdb
platforms: portable Rust and isolated native compatibility crates; storage backends
crate.evidence: All 16 published registry archives, downloaded and hashed, match their crates.io checksums and the source-bound attested candidate manifest. The manifest and both SPDX inventories pass hosted GitHub attestation verification. A clean registry consumer passes in CI. Publication used the crates.io token fallback, not trusted publishing.

cli.evidence: All 12 public assets (five archives, their checksum files, the manifest and SPDX inventory) pass exact-inventory, checksum and hosted GitHub attestation verification. The published macOS arm64 binary passes PQ signing/verification, tamper rejection, custody, re-encryption, rotation and verify-only MCP tests.

wasm.evidence: The registry tarball matches its source-bound attested candidate checksum. It is the package's first publication through its npm trusted publisher, with SLSA provenance. npm signature/provenance audit passes, and the registry-installed package passes PQ signing, verification and identity-transfer tamper tests in Chromium. Its durable checksum and SPDX SBOM are attested.

npm.evidence: The exact registry tarball matches its source-bound attested SHA-256 candidate checksum and was published through npm trusted publishing with SLSA provenance. Registry signature/provenance audit, CJS/ESM loading, CommonJS PQ signing with tamper and wrong-key rejection, public human-approval proof and CI postinstall/CLI shim checks pass; the durable SBOM is attested. No Linux arm64 musl binary ships.

python.evidence: Five abi3 wheels for CPython 3.11 and newer and the source distribution match the source-bound attested candidate checksums, and all six pass PEP 740 verification. Published-wheel checks pass on Python 3.11–3.14; fresh macOS PQ signing, tamper rejection and human-approval proof checks pass.

go.registry: Go module proxy and GitHub Releases
go.evidence: The semantic Go module tag and four native libraries are public; a direct fetch of the tag matches sum.golang.org. All 12 exact release assets pass checksum and hosted attestation verification bound to the release commit. External consumers pass on all four targets; a fresh macOS arm64 consumer also passes after moving the build tree and clearing its environment.
